title: Fairness Interventions: A Study in AI Explainability
reasoning: The paper provides a philosophical and normative analysis of fairness interventions in AI, specifically discussing distributive justice and epistemological interpretations. It evaluates the ethical implications of different fairness metrics (Equalized Odds vs. Demographic Parity) and cites philosophical works like Rawls's 'A Theory of Justice' and Hume's 'A Treatise of Human Nature' to justify its normative preferences.
